stops.name: Lake Weissensee
stops.quote: Lake Weissensee in Carinthia is one of Austria's best-known swimming lakes.
stops.english: Lake Weissensee in Carinthia is one of Austria's best-known swimming lakes.

stops.name: Strandbad Stockenboi
stops.quote: The Strandbad Stockenboi has a lakeside swimming area, water sports, a diving school and spacious lawns for sunbathing.
stops.english: The Strandbad Stockenboi has a lakeside swimming area, water sports, a diving school and spacious lawns for sunbathing.

stops.name: Strandbad Knaller
stops.quote: The Strandbad Knaller combines swimming, wellness and lake views with a beach café, saunas and leisure facilities right on the Weissensee.
stops.english: The Strandbad Knaller combines swimming, wellness and lake views with a beach café, saunas and leisure facilities right on the Weissensee.

stops.name: Naggl
stops.quote: From Naggl, trails lead to alpine pastures, viewpoints and hiking areas in the mountains surrounding Lake Weissensee.
stops.english: From Naggl, trails lead to alpine pastures, viewpoints and hiking areas in the mountains surrounding Lake Weissensee.

stops.name: Naggler Alm
stops.quote: The Naggler Alm can also be reached from here.
stops.english: The Naggler Alm can also be reached from here.

stops.name: Gatschach
stops.quote: From the hamlet of Gatschach, the view stretches across Lake Weissensee and the surrounding mountains.
stops.english: From the hamlet of Gatschach, the view stretches across Lake Weissensee and the surrounding mountains.

stops.name: Neusach
stops.quote: Neusach is situated on the western shore of Lake Weissensee.
stops.english: Neusach is situated on the western shore of Lake Weissensee.

stops.name: Techendorf
stops.quote: Techendorf is the centre of Weissensee.
stops.english: Techendorf is the centre of Weissensee.

stops.name: Slow Trail
stops.quote: The Slow Trail runs along the eastern bank, taking in viewpoints, rest areas and sections right by the water.
stops.english: The Slow Trail runs along the eastern bank, taking in viewpoints, rest areas and sections right by the water.

stops.name: Nordufer-Weg
stops.quote: Weissensee – Nordufer-Weg : Demanding hike with paths along the lakeshore and ascents and descents over stone walls.
stops.english: Weissensee – Nordufer-Weg : Demanding hike with paths along the lakeshore and ascents and descents over stone walls.

stops.name: Hermagorer Bodenalm
stops.quote: This short tour leads through forest and alpine pastures to the Bodenalm, with its own cheese shop.
stops.english: This short tour leads through forest and alpine pastures to the Bodenalm, with its own cheese shop.
